cards.title: Diffusion TV: CRT-Based Art Installation Makes Denoising Process Tangible
cards.why_it_matters: As someone working in generative AI, this offers a novel angle on embodied explainability — using physical interaction to convey the diffusion denoising process rather than diagrams or text.
cards.summary: An interactive art installation uses a modified CRT TV to let audiences physically experience diffusion model denoising. Antenna manipulation controls image clarity, metaphorically enacting the denoising process; a tuning knob switches between three channels of AI-generated animals spanning extinct, endangered, and speculative species. The work frames intermediate generative states as experiential material rather than final outputs.

cards.title: Parametric Amplification Boosts Multiparameter Quantum Estimation in Coupled-Cavity Optomechanics
cards.why_it_matters: For an engineer tracking quantum ML and quantum sensing, this work provides concrete precision bounds and tunable mechanisms for simultaneous estimation of multiple quantum parameters — relevant to quantum hardware benchmarking.
cards.summary: Researchers analyze a coupled-cavity optomechanical system with two-mode squeezed vacuum, intracavity degenerate parametric amplification, and coherent optical feedback for simultaneous estimation of optomechanical coupling strength and cavity dissipation rate. Using Gaussian-state formalism and quantum Fisher information matrices under SLD/RLD frameworks, they find parametric amplification substantially reduces estimation uncertainty across broad operating conditions, while coherent feedback produces nonmonotonic precision changes depending sensitively on reflectivity, phase, squeezing, and thermal occupation.
